items.title: Japan CPI preview: core seen at 2.1%, topping BoJ target for first time since December
items.summary: USD/JPY has held a tight range this month between just under 157 and just under 159, with the 200-day EMA just above 157.50. A firm print would test the lower end of that range, while a soft one would push the pair back toward 159, where intervention risk becomes the main defence for the yen.
items.impactZh: 央行政策预期变化可能提升主要货币对波动，杠杆仓位的保证金与回撤压力上升。
items.impactEn: Shifts in central-bank expectations may increase major-pair volatility and raise margin/drawdown pressure on leveraged positions.
items.summaryZh: 美元/日元本月保持在略低于157至略低于159的紧凑区间， 200日均线略高于157.50。坚挺的印刷品将测试该区间的低端，而软印刷品将把该货币对推回到159 ，在那里，干预风险成为日元的主要防御。
